Climate only: the real-species plant lists were removed, because this game uses its own invented plant families (docs/DESIGN.md §C). climate.temp_c is mean annual °C; moisture is 0 (bone dry) to 1 (waterlogged); altitude_m where given.
name: Dunes
notes: Coastal and inland sand dunes: sand-binding rhizomatous grasses on mobile foredunes, sedges and creeping herbs behind, and scattered pine/juniper/willow scrub on stabilised grey dunes. Drawn on Atlantic and Baltic Europe, eastern and Pacific North America, and Australian foredunes.
